split_metadata.holdout_unit: unordered angle pair, both orders excluded

train.rotation_convention: each object's bounding-box patch, CCW, expanded nearest-neighbor sampling (scipy order=0, grid-constant zero fill), then foreground top-left re-anchored; multiples of 90 use exact numpy.rot90
train.pair_target_convention: infer objects once from the original source, rotate each original patch once by the total angle, and re-anchor at its original top-left
train.recorded_rot90_target_check: exact on native grid before padding
train.object_identity_convention: infer eight-connected components once; retain identities in oracle states
train.invalid_source_policy: exclude whole source if any canonical angle 15 through 180 is empty, clipped, or overlapping
train.raster_reference_convention: two object-patch samplings with persistent identities; invalid states score zero and validity is reported
